semantic_fragments.content: The purpose of Usability Engineering, also known as Human Factors Engineering, for the Infrared Forehead Thermometer is to provide a systematic process to analyze, specify, develop, and evaluate the usability of the device in relation to safety. This process aims to assess and mitigate risks associated with normal use. By considering the specific needs and abilities of users, Usability Engineering enhances the usability, safety, and user experience of the Infrared Forehead Thermometer, reducing the likelihood of errors and optimizing the overall effectiveness.

Usability Engineering File table of contents covers: Executive summary (purpose, usability engineering process, file, tailoring, conclusion), Summary of use specification (intended medical indication, patient population, operator, user profile, use environment, operating principle), Description of user interface (characteristics related to safety, potential use errors), Summary of known use problems, Summary of hazard-related use scenarios, Perform user interface design, Establish user interface evaluation plan (formative and summative), Summary of formative evaluations (usability test: environment, critical tasks, knowledge assessment, data analysis, result), Summative evaluation, Conclusion (modifications, further improvement), Other requirements (personnel qualification, DHF requirement).
